The fact that the story is coming out either way isn’t a reason to print it. I get what you’re saying, but the fact that everyone else lowers their standards can’t force you to go along.

All the same, there are some stories you won’t be able to completely confirm. The issue comes when the unconfirmable thing is a potentially libelous accusation. Rape, child abuse… very hard to imagine relying on one source with such serious things.

One major assault allegation I looked into fell apart on that last point.  I’d be worried about litigation if an accuser had a record of lying in court, say. It doesn’t mean the person’s story is untrue, it just means there are some vessels you can’t take to sea.
